shared_elements: motifs arranged in multiple parallel registers or panels
linear outline drawing with no infill
surface largely filled with repeated angular pattern
bovine/horned skull (actual in A, no clear counterpart in B)
justification: Both surfaces are covered by repeated spiky, toothed zigzag motifs drawn as bare outlines and stacked in several parallel registers, a reasonably specific shared decorative scheme rather than a mere generic 'pattern'. The chief difference in depicted content is that B also carries recognisable schematic creatures with dot-eyes and striped bodies among the zigzags, while A shows only the abstract panels set beside a mounted horned skull, and A's registers run as vertical panels rather than sweeping bands.
